The '''''Hard Shell''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Class-7 Repair Vessel]] produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. Deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jatee]], the ''Hard Shell'' was hijacked by agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in an attempt to take Dr. [[Soron Hegerty]] offworld.
